blocks.text: 4. Gemini Decisions API
The Gemini Decisions API, powered by Gemini Decision 1 evaluates text, images, video, PDFs, or audio across up to 256K tokens against up to 1,000 isolated questions with 0 output tokens billed.

blocks.text: Three question types return calibrated probabilities and a confidence score: noul for binary yes/no checks, choice across 2 to 255 discrete keys, and score for ordered rubrics. inlines.text: 5. Bring your own sandbox for managed agents

blocks.text: Gemini Managed Agents now supports self-hosted environments. We run model inference and the agent loop on Google infrastructure while bash commands and file edits execute inside your compute.

inlines.text: . We run model inference and the agent loop on Google infrastructure while bash commands and file edits execute inside your compute.

blocks.text: Your worker connects over outbound HTTPS with a scoped key and zero inbound firewall ports. In production, you can deploy across Modal, E2B, Cloudflare, Daytona, Fly.io, Vercel, or Cloud Run using our self-hosted provider manifests.
